title: 中文大學的一天 CUHK in a day
creator: See-ming Lee 李思明 / SML Photography / SML Universe Limited
authorCaptureRange: 2013-03-12 18:14:01 to 2013-03-13 18:00:01 GMT+08:00, one minute intervals, 1427 original RAW photographs
playbackMapping: Uses a nominal 60-second source interval for each of 1424 clean public video frames, followed by a 17-minute interpolation between the last and first photograph. The transcoded public video does not retain original per-photo timestamps.
modifications: Kept clean scene frames 0..1423; removed the end credit slate and soundtrack; re-encoded for local precise frame seeking. Credits are retained here, in the application description and ASSET_CREDITS.md. Poster is actual source frame 1000. No AI image generation, upscaling or city reconstruction.
limitations: The creator describes a 1080p master, but the publicly downloadable Flickr file is only 720p. We do not claim native 4K detail. The sequence records one day's weather, light, artificial lamps and Moon; solar-time mapping changes timing, not the recorded solar angle, season, weather or lunar phase. Coordinates are a playback daylight reference, not a surveyed camera position.
